bindings.provenance: set_current_page emits switch-page and notify::page only on change (Gtk 4 docs)

provenance.ref: the GtkNotebookPage:tab-label property only stores a string; it does not create the visible tab label (GTK 4.22)

lifetime.provenance: derived: GtkWidget (floating ref sunk by the handle table; the parent holds a ref while inserted)

annotated.provenance: GtkNotebook:page (Gtk 4 docs); needs pages, set up in the test

properties.name: page
properties.setup: let nb = h.obj(o).downcast::<gtk::Notebook>().unwrap(); for _ in 0..8 { nb.append_page(&gtk::Label::new(None), None::<&gtk::Widget>); }

trigger.rust: let nb = o.downcast_ref::<gtk::Notebook>().unwrap(); while nb.n_pages() < 3 { nb.append_page(&gtk::Label::new(None), None::<&gtk::Widget>); } nb.set_current_page(Some(((i + 1) % 3) as u32));
